command:
for n in /sys/class/drm/card*-*; do [ -d "$n" ] || continue; printf '
CONNECTOR %s
' "$n"; for f in status enabled modes; do if [ -r "$n/$f" ]; then printf '%s: ' "$f"; cat "$n/$f"; fi; done; if [ -r "$n/edid" ]; then printf 'edid_bytes: '; wc -c < "$n/edid"; fi; done; printf '
DRIVER
'; readlink -f /sys/class/drm/card0/device/driver; modetest -D /dev/dri/card0 -c 2>&1 | head -n 180
